integrity: Analytic proof and a deterministic independent numerical checker; no external mathematical audit or machine-certified proof.
scientific_limitations: The general isotropic formula is derived from prior-available tangential polygon radial moments. Only the complete two-rotation strict order and the three-rotation majorization counterexample are asserted as new. The three-rotation reversal is local as epsilon tends to zero, not a complete optimization of all gap lists; historical priority is not independently verified.
title: Affine isotropic ordering for two rotated regular polygons and a three-rotation majorization obstruction
